purpose: Plan image-to-video start/end frames without confusing them with master storyboard frames.

asset_classes.clip_start_frame: Image-to-video opening control frame for a clip.
asset_classes.clip_end_frame: Image-to-video landing frame for a clip.
asset_classes.bridge_frame: Optional non-story connector between two approved story beats.
asset_classes.master_story_frame: The primary storyboard frame that expresses the shot beat.

may_chain_when: same location or clearly continuous path
the end pose of clip A naturally motivates the start of clip B
must_break_when: character or prop continuity cannot be guaranteed

end_frame.prompt_intent: Same shot intent, same character and space, later pose/action landing only.

connection_to_next.reason: Explain why continuity should or should not carry across.
